_comment: Donor provenance of the universal fact pack: one entry per decomp game whose truth feeds it. license is the SPDX id GitHub reports for the repo, verbatim (NONE = no license file, NOASSERTION = a license file GitHub cannot classify). Every donor is included whatever its license (user decision): the pack holds facts only (digests, names, sizes, prototype text), never code bytes; dropping a donor is a rebuild without it. compiler: the `compiler` field of the game's truth/meta.json, verbatim. twin_group: games of one source tree that are never used to evaluate each other.
